title: Auto Layout 约束布局
markdown:
# Auto Layout 约束布局 ## 概述 Auto Layout 是 UIKit 的布局引擎，通过**约束（Constraints）**描述视图之间的空间关系，从而实现在不同屏幕尺寸、旋转方向和动态字体下的自适应布局。 本篇将从最基础的 NSLayoutConstraint 到 Anchor API、优先级系统、Safe Area 以及动态约束进行全面讲解。 ```mermaid flowchart TD AL["Auto Layout Engine"] --> C["NSLayoutConstraint"] AL --> A["Anchor API"] AL --> IC["intrinsicContentSize"] C --> EQ["item1.attr = multiplier × item2.attr + constant"] A --> LA["leadingAnchor / trailingAnchor"] A --> SA["safeAreaLayoutGuide"] IC --> CH["contentHuggingPriority"] IC --> CR["compressionResistancePriority"] ``` ## 核心概念 Auto Layout 把布局描述为**约束方程**：每个约束都是线性方程 `item1.attr = multiplier × item2.attr + constant`，布局引擎求解整个方程组得到每个视图的 frame。 - **声明关系，而非坐标**：只描述视图之间的相对关系，引擎负责在任意屏幕尺寸下求解 - **优先级协调冲突**：约束可有优先级，引擎按优先级满足，必要时打破低优先级约束 - **内在内容尺寸**：`UILabel` 等视图有 `intrinsicContentSize`，其「拉伸/压缩倾向」由两个优先级控制 | 概念 | 说明 | | :------------------------------ | :----------------------------------- | | 约束（Constraint） | 描述视图间关系的线性方程 | | Anchor API | 类型安全地创建约束的推荐方式 | | `contentHuggingPriority` | 抗拉伸：值越高越不愿被拉大 | | `compressionResistancePriority` | 抗压缩：值越高越不愿被压小 | | Safe Area | 自动避让刘海、Home Indicator、导航栏 | ## 基础用法 ### translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints 使用代码创建约束时，必须将 `translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints` 设为 `false`，否则系统生成的 autoresizing 约束会与你的手动约束冲突。 ```swift import UIKit class BasicLayoutViewController: UIViewController { override func viewDidLoad() { super.viewDidLoad() view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground let redBox = UIView() redBox.backgroundColor = .systemRed redBox.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false view.addSubview(redBox) NSLayoutConstraint.activate([ redBox.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor), redBox.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerYAnchor), redBox.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 200), redBox.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 200), ]) } } ``` ### Anchor API 全览 Anchor API 是创建约束的首选方式，类型安全且可读性强： ```swift class AnchorDemoViewController: UIViewController { override func viewDidLoad() { super.viewDidLoad() view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground let header = UIView() header.backgroundColor = .systemBlue header.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false let body = UIView() body.backgroundColor = .systemGray5 body.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false view.addSubview(header) view.addSubview(body) let safeArea = view.safeAreaLayoutGuide NSLayoutConstraint.activate([ header.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.topAnchor), header.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.leadingAnchor), header.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.trailingAnchor), header.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 120), body.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: header.bottomAnchor, constant: 16), body.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.leadingAnchor, constant: 16), body.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.trailingAnchor, constant: -16), body.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.bottomAnchor, constant: -16), ]) } } ``` 常用 Anchor 对照表： | Anchor | 用途 | | :------------------------------------------- | :----------------------- | | `topAnchor` / `bottomAnchor` | 垂直方向边界 | | `leadingAnchor` / `trailingAnchor` | 水平方向边界（支持 RTL） | | `centerXAnchor` / `centerYAnchor` | 居中对齐 | | `widthAnchor` / `heightAnchor` | 尺寸约束 | | `firstBaselineAnchor` / `lastBaselineAnchor` | 文本基线对齐 | ## 进阶用法 ### intrinsicContentSize 与优先级 UILabel、UIButton 等控件拥有**固有内容尺寸**（intrinsicContentSize）。当多个控件竞争空间时，通过优先级决定谁伸展、谁压缩。 ```mermaid flowchart LR L["UILabel A"] --- SPACE["Available Space"] --- R["UILabel B"] SPACE --> HUG["contentHuggingPriority
Higher = resists stretching"] SPACE --> COMP["compressionResistancePriority
Higher = resists compression"] ``` ```swift class PriorityDemoViewController: UIViewController { override func viewDidLoad() { super.viewDidLoad() view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground let titleLabel = UILabel() titleLabel.text = "标题" titleLabel.font = .preferredFont(forTextStyle: .headline) titleLabel.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false let descriptionLabel = UILabel() descriptionLabel.text = "这是一段很长很长的描述文本，可能会被截断或者压缩" descriptionLabel.font = .preferredFont(forTextStyle: .body) descriptionLabel.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false titleLabel.setContentHuggingPriority(.required, for: .horizontal) titleLabel.setContentCompressionResistancePriority(.required, for: .horizontal) descriptionLabel.setContentHuggingPriority(.defaultLow, for: .horizontal) descriptionLabel.setContentCompressionResistancePriority(.defaultLow, for: .horizontal) view.addSubview(titleLabel) view.addSubview(descriptionLabel) NSLayoutConstraint.activate([ titleLabel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.leadingAnchor, constant: 16), titleLabel.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerYAnchor), descriptionLabel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: titleLabel.trailingAnchor, constant: 8), descriptionLabel.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.trailingAnchor, constant: -16), descriptionLabel.centerYAnchor.constraint(equalTo: titleLabel.centerYAnchor), ]) } } ``` **优先级规则**： - `contentHuggingPriority` 越高 → 越不想被拉伸（紧抱内容） - `compressionResistancePriority` 越高 → 越不想被压缩（抵抗压缩） - 默认值都是 `250`（hugging）和 `750`（compression resistance） ### 动态约束（激活/停用） ```swift class AdaptiveLayoutViewController: UIViewController { private var portraitConstraints: [NSLayoutConstraint] = [] private var landscapeConstraints: [NSLayoutConstraint] = [] private let imageView = UIImageView() private let textLabel = UILabel() override func viewDidLoad() { super.viewDidLoad() view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground imageView.backgroundColor = .systemTeal imageView.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false textLabel.text = "自适应布局示例" textLabel.numberOfLines = 0 textLabel.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false view.addSubview(imageView) view.addSubview(textLabel) let safeArea = view.safeAreaLayoutGuide portraitConstraints = [ imageView.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.topAnchor, constant: 16), imageView.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.leadingAnchor, constant: 16), imageView.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.trailingAnchor, constant: -16), imageView.heightAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.heightAnchor, multiplier: 0.4), textLabel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: imageView.bottomAnchor, constant: 16), textLabel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.leadingAnchor, constant: 16), textLabel.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.trailingAnchor, constant: -16), ] landscapeConstraints = [ imageView.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.topAnchor, constant: 16), imageView.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.leadingAnchor, constant: 16), imageView.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.bottomAnchor, constant: -16), imageView.widthAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.widthAnchor, multiplier: 0.4), textLabel.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.topAnchor, constant: 16), textLabel.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: imageView.trailingAnchor, constant: 16), textLabel.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: safeArea.trailingAnchor, constant: -16), ] applyCurrentLayout() } override func viewWillTransition( to size: CGSize, with coordinator: UIViewControllerTransitionCoordinator ) { super.viewWillTransition(to: size, with: coordinator) coordinator.animate { _ in self.applyCurrentLayout() } } private func applyCurrentLayout() { let isLandscape = view.bounds.width > view.bounds.height NSLayoutConstraint.deactivate(isLandscape ? portraitConstraints : landscapeConstraints) NSLayoutConstraint.activate(isLandscape ? landscapeConstraints : portraitConstraints) } } ``` ### 约束动画 修改约束的 `constant` 后调用 `layoutIfNeeded` 即可产生动画效果： ```swift class AnimatedConstraintViewController: UIViewController { private var boxTopConstraint: NSLayoutConstraint! private let box = UIView() override func viewDidLoad() { super.viewDidLoad() view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground box.backgroundColor = .systemIndigo box.layer.cornerRadius = 12 box.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false view.addSubview(box) boxTopConstraint = box.topAnchor.constraint( equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor, constant: 40 ) NSLayoutConstraint.activate([ boxTopConstraint, box.centerXAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.centerXAnchor), box.widthAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 100), box.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 100), ]) let tap = UITapGestureRecognizer(target: self, action: #selector(handleTap)) view.addGestureRecognizer(tap) } @objc private func handleTap() { boxTopConstraint.constant = boxTopConstraint.constant == 40 ? 300 : 40 UIView.animate(withDuration: 0.5, delay: 0, usingSpringWithDamping: 0.6, initialSpringVelocity: 0) { self.view.layoutIfNeeded() } } } ``` ## 完整示例 一个自适应表单布局，综合运用 Safe Area、优先级、动态约束和键盘适配： ```swift import UIKit class FormViewController: UIViewController { private let scrollView = UIScrollView() private let contentView = UIView() private let nameField = UITextField() private let emailField = UITextField() private let submitButton = UIButton(type: .system) private var bottomConstraint: NSLayoutConstraint! override func viewDidLoad() { super.viewDidLoad() view.backgroundColor = .systemBackground title = "注册表单" setupScrollView() setupForm() observeKeyboard() } private func setupScrollView() { scrollView.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false contentView.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false view.addSubview(scrollView) scrollView.addSubview(contentView) bottomConstraint = scrollView.bottomAnchor.constraint( equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.bottomAnchor ) NSLayoutConstraint.activate([ scrollView.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.safeAreaLayoutGuide.topAnchor), scrollView.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.leadingAnchor), scrollView.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: view.trailingAnchor), bottomConstraint, contentView.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scrollView.contentLayoutGuide.topAnchor), contentView.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scrollView.contentLayoutGuide.leadingAnchor), contentView.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scrollView.contentLayoutGuide.trailingAnchor), contentView.bottomAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scrollView.contentLayoutGuide.bottomAnchor), contentView.widthAnchor.constraint(equalTo: scrollView.frameLayoutGuide.widthAnchor), ]) } private func setupForm() { let stack = UIStackView(arrangedSubviews: [ makeFieldGroup(title: "姓名", field: nameField), makeFieldGroup(title: "邮箱", field: emailField), submitButton, ]) stack.axis = .vertical stack.spacing = 24 stack.translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false nameField.borderStyle = .roundedRect emailField.borderStyle = .roundedRect emailField.keyboardType = .emailAddress submitButton.setTitle("提交", for: .normal) submitButton.titleLabel?.font = .preferredFont(forTextStyle: .headline) submitButton.backgroundColor = .systemBlue submitButton.setTitleColor(.white, for: .normal) submitButton.layer.cornerRadius = 10 submitButton.heightAnchor.constraint(equalToConstant: 50).isActive = true contentView.addSubview(stack) NSLayoutConstraint.activate([ stack.topAnchor.constraint(equalTo: contentView.topAnchor, constant: 32), stack.leadingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: contentView.leadingAnchor, constant: 24), stack.trailingAnchor.constraint(equalTo: contentView.trailingAnchor, constant: -24), stack.bottomAnchor.constraint(lessThanOrEqualTo: contentView.bottomAnchor, constant: -32), ]) } private func makeFieldGroup(title: String, field: UITextField) -> UIView { let label = UILabel() label.text = title label.font = .preferredFont(forTextStyle: .subheadline) let stack = UIStackView(arrangedSubviews: [label, field]) stack.axis = .vertical stack.spacing = 8 return stack } private func observeKeyboard() { NotificationCenter.default.addObserver( self, selector: #selector(keyboardWillChange), name: UIResponder.keyboardWillChangeFrameNotification, object: nil ) } @objc private func keyboardWillChange(_ note: Notification) { guard let frame = note.userInfo?[UIResponder.keyboardFrameEndUserInfoKey] as? CGRect, let duration = note.userInfo?[UIResponder.keyboardAnimationDurationUserInfoKey] as? Double else { return } let keyboardHeight = view.frame.height - frame.origin.y bottomConstraint.constant = keyboardHeight > 0 ? -keyboardHeight : 0 UIView.animate(withDuration: duration) { self.view.layoutIfNeeded() } } } ``` ## 最佳实践 | 推荐做法 | 不推荐做法 | | :----------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------- | | 使用 Anchor API 创建约束 | 使用 `NSLayoutConstraint(item:attribute:...)` 长形式 | | 始终设置 `translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false` | 忘记设置导致约束冲突 | | 使用 `safeAreaLayoutGuide` 适配刘海屏 | 直接约束到 `view.topAnchor`（被状态栏遮挡） | | 用 `NSLayoutConstraint.activate([])` 批量激活 | 逐个设置 `constraint.isActive = true` | | 通过优先级解决 ambiguous layout | 添加多余的固定尺寸约束 | | 动画时修改 `constant` + `layoutIfNeeded()` | 移除旧约束再创建新约束来实现动画 | | 使用 `UIStackView` 简化线性布局 | 手动为每个子视图写间距约束 | ## 小结 - Auto Layout 通过约束描述视图间关系，核心公式为 `item1.attr = multiplier × item2.attr + constant` - Anchor API 是创建约束的推荐方式，类型安全且简洁 - 代码布局必须设置 `translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints = false` - `contentHuggingPriority` 控制拉伸倾向，`compressionResistancePriority` 控制压缩倾向 - Safe Area 自动适配刘海屏、Home Indicator 和导航栏 - 动态约束通过 `activate`/`deactivate` 切换，配合 `layoutIfNeeded()` 实现动画 - `UIStackView` 大幅简化线性排列的约束代码
